test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statements: All flowers are trees. Some trees are plants.

Conclusions:

I. Some flowers are plants.

II. All flowers are plants.
solution:
**Statements:**

All flowers are trees.

Some trees are plants.

**Conclusions:**

**The least possible venn diagram is given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bd06e337ebbf9f71a7bb54bd79063ee6668834771b0cb1a9855c700942d8d61.png] 

I. Some flowers are plants - **False**(because, there is no definite relation is given between them so, it can be possible only).

II. All flowers are plants - False(because, there is no definite relation is given between them so, it can be possible only).

Thus, Neither I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
